warranty.devices: All HiDow TENS/EMS devices come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.
warranty.accessories: Electrode pads, wraps, and accessories carry a 90-day warranty.
warranty.claim: To file a warranty claim, contact support@hidow.com or call (314) 569-2888 with your order number.
warranty.exclusions: Warranty does not cover damage from misuse, water damage, or normal wear and tear on electrode pads.

shipping.standard: Standard shipping: 5-7 business days (free on orders $99+).
shipping.international: International shipping available to select countries. Contact us for rates.
shipping.processing: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days.

returns.window: 30-day return policy on unopened, unused products in original packaging.
returns.process: Contact returns@hidow.com or call (314) 569-2888 to initiate a return.
returns.refund: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after item is received.
returns.exceptions: Electrode pads and opened accessories are non-returnable for hygiene reasons.

payment.methods: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, and Affirm (buy now, pay later).
payment.affirm: Affirm financing available at checkout — 0% APR options for qualified buyers.
payment.security: All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.

clinical.fda: All HiDow TENS/EMS devices are FDA-cleared for over-the-counter use.
clinical.contraindications: Do not use if you have a pacemaker, are pregnant, have epilepsy, or have active cancer. Consult your physician if unsure.
clinical.electrodes: Do not place electrodes over the heart, on the head, over broken skin, or near water.
clinical.sessions: Typical session: 20-30 minutes, 1-3 times per day. Start at low intensity and increase gradually.
